displayAddress: North Row, Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire, MK9 3NS
description:
King Estate Agents are pleased to present this impressive townhouse in the heart of Milton Keynes City Centre, conveniently located within walking distance of a wide range of amenities, including Campbell Park and MK Central Railway Station.

Offering stylish and contemporary living across three floors, this desirable three-bedroom home features a spacious dual-aspect living room with two balconies, one of which overlooks beautifully maintained communal gardens. Combining generous accommodation with a modern finish throughout, the property is perfectly suited to city-centre living.

Upon entering the home, a central staircase provides access to both the lower ground and first-floor levels. Descending to the lower ground floor, you are welcomed into a stylish open-plan kitchen and dining area, perfectly designed for modern family living and entertaining. The contemporary kitchen features sleek white cabinetry, contrasting stone-effect worktops, and a range of integrated appliances.

Generous rear-facing windows allow an abundance of natural light to fill the space, while sliding doors lead directly to a private courtyard garden, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. This level is further enhanced by a convenient cloakroom and a useful storage cupboard.

The first floor is home to an exceptionally bright and spacious dual-aspect living room, enhanced by two balconies to the front and rear. The rear balcony enjoys a south-west facing aspect, capturing afternoon and evening sunshine while overlooking the attractive communal gardens. Also on this floor is the third bedroom. 

On the second floor, there are two generously sized double bedrooms, both benefiting from fitted wardrobes. A stylish family bathroom serves this level, featuring contemporary four piece bathroom suite. 

Despite its central location, this property enjoys the rare advantage of three separate outdoor spaces, including a generous low-maintenance private garden. The home is further complemented by beautifully landscaped communal gardens, featuring mature trees and attractive green spaces that create a peaceful setting within the development.

The vendor has advised there is a service charge of £2948.30 per annum, and a reserve fund contribution payable of £1308.12 per annum.
